text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's Falco, who's
a teeny bit scared of the number 18☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
An autograph? A handshake?
Thanks for always cheering me on♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, it's just you, Trainer!
Sorry, I was spacing out☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Narrator
choice_data_list: The race is coming up. Focus!
The race is coming up. Focus!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Sorry, sorry! I won't space out anymore!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's the 3rd race in our "1st place in everything" streak.
Right at the halfway mark, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I've gotta score a decisive victory here
and pull everyone tight into my embrace☆!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though the smile felt slightly forced,
it seemed her usual focus had returned.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Let's talk. But those words
were cut short with a smile."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Falco is gonna stay super focused and run her best!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"So please, just leave me alone for now.
Right now, I just have to win."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Win, win, and keep on winning.
Beyond that, I know an electric,
roaring Oi Racecourse is waiting...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So... please.
Keep watching over me like you always do!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her smile brooked no argument.
In that moment, all I could do was nod.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Falco's definitely gonna bring home a win!
